en.title: Compute Number Score
en.description:
Compute the score of a positive integer n from its decimal representation; the following independent rules may score the same digit more than once: add 2 for each digit 5; add 4 for each pair of adjacent digits 33; for each maximal run in which each digit is exactly 1 greater than the previous one, add L², where L is the run length; add 6 if n is divisible by 5; add 1 for each odd digit.

The input/output protocol and the limits marked as 'added by this site' were compiled by this site; limits not given in the original problem are not treated as part of the original source.
en.input: One line containing a positive decimal integer with no sign and no leading zeros. Added by this site: at most 100000 digits.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the algorithm idea, proof of correctness, and complexity.
